name: now.farout/experiences
title: FarOut
description: Find intense, bookable experiences and crazy skills to learn, from a source-cited catalogue.

tools.name: find_experiences
tools.description: Rank FarOut's 558 checked experiences against what the user wants: kind, month or dates, budget, where they leave from and how long they will fly. Returns up to 25, each with the price as the operator states it, the next date or the season, an estimated flight time from the user's city, how sure the facts are and the page to book from. When nothing meets every limit, the closest are returned and the limits they break are named. Read-only.

description.description: What the user wants in their own words, e.g. "something crazy in December, a short flight from Amsterdam, under 1,000 euros".

kinds.description: Kinds of experience: air, water, ice, fire-earth, science, wildlife, speed, summits, events, stays, body-mind, skills.

themes.description: Lenses: crazy, access (places most people cannot get into), nature, culture, deal.

from_city.description: Where the user leaves from (a city or airport code); travel time is estimated from it.

max_flight_hours.description: The longest flight the user accepts, in hours.

max_budget_eur.description: Budget ceiling for the experience itself, in euros.

beginner_friendly.description: Only experiences that need no licence, certificate or prior experience.

sort.description: best (default), craziest, cheapest, closest or soonest.

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Return one experience in full: price and what it includes, season and dates, duration, how to book and how far ahead it fills, the gateway airport, the catch, requirements, and where and when its facts were read. Pass the slug from a find_experiences result, or a name. Read-only.

slug.description: The experience's slug or page URL, as returned in details_url.

name.description: The experience or operator name when no slug is known.
